defmodule ChatServer.Socket do
  use Phoenix.Socket
  require Logger

  channel "room:*", ChatServer.RoomChannel
  channel "dm:*", ChatServer.DirectMessageChannel

  @impl true
  def connect(%{"token" => token}, socket, _connect_info) do
    case ChatServer.Auth.verify_token(token) do
      {:ok, user_id} ->
        {:ok, assign(socket, :user_id, user_id)}
      {:error, _reason} ->
        :error
    end
  end

  def connect(_params, _socket, _connect_info), do: :error

  @impl true
  def id(socket), do: "users_socket:#{socket.assigns.user_id}"
end

defmodule ChatServer.DirectMessageChannel do
  use Phoenix.Channel
  require Logger

  alias ChatServer.{RateLimiter, MessageStore, Auth}

  @max_retries 3
  @retry_delay_ms 100

  @impl true
  def join("dm:" <> conversation_id, _params, socket) do
    user_id = socket.assigns.user_id
    case authorize_conversation_access(user_id, conversation_id) do
      :ok ->
        messages = MessageStore.get_recent(conversation_id, 50)
        {:ok, %{messages: messages}, assign(socket, :conversation_id, conversation_id)}
      {:error, :unauthorized} ->
        {:error, %{reason: "unauthorized"}}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_in("send_message", %{"body" => body, "recipient_id" => recipient_id}, socket) do
    user_id = socket.assigns.user_id
    conversation_id = socket.assigns.conversation_id

    with :ok <- RateLimiter.check(user_id, :send_message),
         :ok <- validate_message_body(body),
         {:ok, msg} <- deliver_with_retry(user_id, recipient_id, conversation_id, body, 0) do
      broadcast!(socket, "new_message", %{from: user_id, body: body, id: msg.id})
      {:reply, {:ok, %{message_id: msg.id}}, socket}
    else
      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        {:reply, {:error, %{reason: "rate_limited"}}, socket}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, %{reason: to_string(reason)}}, socket}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_in("fetch_history", %{"before_id" => before_id, "limit" => limit}, socket) do
    conversation_id = socket.assigns.conversation_id
    safe_limit = min(limit, 100)
    messages = MessageStore.get_before(conversation_id, before_id, safe_limit)
    {:reply, {:ok, %{messages: messages}}, socket}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_in("transfer_conversation", %{"new_owner_id" => new_owner_id}, socket) do
    user_id = socket.assigns.user_id
    conversation_id = socket.assigns.conversation_id

    with :ok <- RateLimiter.check(user_id, :transfer),
         :ok <- verify_ownership(user_id, conversation_id),
         {:ok, updated} <- do_transfer(conversation_id, new_owner_id, socket) do
      {:reply, {:ok, %{transferred: true}}, updated}
    else
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:reply, {:error, %{reason: to_string(reason)}}, socket}
    end
  end

  defp do_transfer(conversation_id, new_owner_id, socket) do
    case MessageStore.transfer_ownership(conversation_id, new_owner_id) do
      {:ok, _} ->
        updated_socket = assign(socket, :user_id, new_owner_id)
        {:ok, updated_socket}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp deliver_with_retry(sender_id, recipient_id, conversation_id, body, attempt) when attempt < @max_retries do
    case MessageStore.insert(%{
      sender_id: sender_id,
      recipient_id: recipient_id,
      conversation_id: conversation_id,
      body: body,
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
    }) do
      {:ok, msg} ->
        {:ok, msg}
      {:error, :conflict} ->
        Process.sleep(@retry_delay_ms * (attempt + 1))
        deliver_with_retry(sender_id, recipient_id, conversation_id, body, attempt + 1)
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp deliver_with_retry(_sender_id, _recipient_id, _conversation_id, _body, _attempt) do
    {:error, :max_retries_exceeded}
  end

  defp authorize_conversation_access(user_id, conversation_id) do
    case MessageStore.get_conversation_participants(conversation_id) do
      {:ok, participants} ->
        if user_id in participants, do: :ok, else: {:error, :unauthorized}
      {:error, _} ->
        {:error, :unauthorized}
    end
  end

  defp verify_ownership(user_id, conversation_id) do
    case MessageStore.get_conversation_owner(conversation_id) do
      {:ok, ^user_id} -> :ok
      _ -> {:error, :not_owner}
    end
  end

  defp validate_message_body(body) when is_binary(body) and byte_size(body) > 0 and byte_size(body) <= 4096, do: :ok
  defp validate_message_body(_), do: {:error, :invalid_message}
end

defmodule ChatServer.RateLimiter do
  use GenServer

  @limits %{
    send_message: {20, 60_000},
    transfer: {2, 300_000}
  }

  def start_link(opts), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)

  def check(user_id, action) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check, user_id, action})
  end

  @impl true
  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:check, user_id, action}, _from, state) do
    {max_count, window_ms} = Map.get(@limits, action, {10, 60_000})
    key = {user_id, action}
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)

    entries = Map.get(state, key, [])
    valid_entries = Enum.filter(entries, fn ts -> now - ts < window_ms end)

    if length(valid_entries) < max_count do
      new_state = Map.put(state, key, [now | valid_entries])
      {:reply, :ok, new_state}
    else
      {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
    end
  end
end
